descriptions.w3d_d40j_reset_queue_times_80164070: Rewrites each of the task manager's three category timer queues (real STLport priority_queue of {handle,value}) with every value except -1 replaced by the new time, then sets the manager's time fields through 0x8034b3f8 and 0x8034b408 and calls the empty hook 0x801651e4. Returns 0. Names are inferred.
